title: tracy_site page.create makes a page and its menu link in one call on WordPress, Joomla and EmDash: the theme's own markup the quickstart's map pins, the CMS's own page and menu doors, one apply id so one apply.revert takes both back, and a menu that cannot place the link is refused before anything is written
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout run: node --test --test-reporter=tap packages/tools/tracy-site-tools/test/page-create.test.mjs packages/tools/tracy-site-tools/test/surface.test.mjs packages/tools/tracy-site-tools/test/consistency.test.mjs
S2: Read the exit code, the `# pass`, `# fail`, `# skipped` and `# cancelled` lines and the tests named below.
expect: S1 exits 0 with 0 failures, 0 skipped, 0 cancelled.

WordPress: 'the FAQ page in the theme's own section markup and its link after "Services"' passes: a published page whose body is the wtb-text section with one point per question in order, a navigation-link after Services in the header menu, both writes under one apply_id, the receipt names the path and the menu entry.

Joomla: 'the article joins the category of the page it follows, its menu item lands after it' passes: article (introtext "" included), menu item of the same language, move_after the item named, three writes under one apply_id; the menu a visitor reads shows the new item right after it.

EmDash: 'a published entry of the pages collection in the map's Markdown, and its menu row after "Services"' passes: content_create then menu_set_items with every item and the row after Services, the menu read before the entry is made.

'an item no menu holds is refused before anything is written' (WordPress, Joomla, EmDash) pass: NOT_FOUND with the menus listed and no write; 'a menu write refused after the page was made takes the page back' passes.
'page.create is a tracy_site action on WordPress, Joomla and EmDash surfaces' passes and the surface and consistency suites stay green.

selectors.action: tracy_site page.create {title, body:[{title?, text}], menu:{after?, name?}, locale?}
selectors.answer: ok, page{id,title,path,locale}, menu{menu,label,after}, apply_id, verified[], undo, next

evidence: Flow D bench 05/10/2026, M-L3-new-page-menu: 'Common questions' with three Q&As after Services took 25 calls on WordPress (7 content.get, theme pattern and SCSS reads), 26 on Joomla (a refused article for its missing introtext) and 22 on EmDash, before two to four writes.
fence: Mechanism only: the page.create job over the package's fakes per CMS (WordPress component, open Joomla component, EmDash door). Not covered: a live site's rendering of the page or its cache, and the model choosing page.create over the older recipe.
